_: Locked UI contract for the Krane B2C prototype.
Everything listed here was agreed with the client and must not disappear.
b2c/tools/contract-check.mjs asserts every line of this file against the
running page; CI fails the build if something has been removed.
Adding to this file is normal. Removing from it needs the client to say so,
and the reason belongs in the commit message and in _removed below.
_removed: noslots (SCR-007), 31 Aug: a second design for picking a consultation time,
reachable only from the demo rail's error link. #appointment (SCR-007B) now
owns that job for every route, so the two patterns no longer disagree in the
same build. Client approved retiring it before the round-2 test link.
refill (SCR-059), 1 Sep: a whole screen for ticking prescriptions before the
checkout. Client: the patient already knows what they take, so #refill-sheet
asks which prescription (or all of them) and hands the answer straight to
#payment, the same checkout every other order goes through.
scroll-text landing band, 11 Sep: the message no longer opens the page. It
moved into the empty space after the positioning statement, where the word
by word rise has room to read and does not compete with the hero headline.
treatment-detail Documents tab, 11 Sep: client moved the medical certificate
to the end of the treatment plan and the receipt to the paid tracking step.
All documents are now indexed by the searchable My Documents profile page.

components.why: Review after the medicine arrives. Went missing once already.
Doctor advice rating.
App experience rating.
Video and sound quality rating.
Patient confirms receipt on the Delivered step.
Three safety questions, asked at confirmation.
Missing the 5-minute entry window has to offer a re-match, not a dead end.
The entry window is counted down on the waiting room, not left implicit.
Registration-complete confirmation after OTP.
Payment method sheet, tap to commit.
Every route into a refill: the quick menu, the treatment detail and the demo rail.
Refill asks which prescription, or all of them, then goes straight to the checkout. Replaced the #refill screen.
The refill picker needs an explicit close control in addition to its dismissible scrim.
Receipt is linked from the paid step in order tracking.
The treatment's medical certificate is the final section of its treatment plan.
Entry point for the searchable document library. It sits in settings, which profile opens; it was listed against #profile from when the row lived there.
Patients can search all of their documents.
Patients can order documents by newest or oldest date.
The document library contains date-indexed document rows.
Address search box with suggestions.
Suggestion dropdown.

Map picker entry point. Was the 'แก้ไขที่อยู่' link to #address-map; the client's 5 Oct mockup drops it, because the fields that screen held are on the form now, and the way into the map is the pill on the map preview.
Real OpenStreetMap tiles. They moved with the pin picker into the current-location dialog when #address-map was retired.
Confirming the pin fills the address form.

Address fields stay grouped, not one flat run: where to send it, the address itself, who receives it, what to call it. Two of those four are .form-group and two are not, so the check names the sections rather than the class.
Every typed address field can be cleared. Five: the search, the address line, the rider note and the two recipient names — the four cascade selects clear by picking the blank option instead.
Category grid. Its container was dropped once and blanked the screen.
Second-step condition list.
Camera/mic precondition as a one-line chip.
Hang-up control.
Live-call pill in chat.
Home primary action.
Settings exposes the current language as a named dropdown instead of an abbreviation toggle.
A follow-up inside the 24-hour notice window appears on the profile with a live countdown.
The consolidated follow-up hub keeps every active case connected to its treatment plan.
The nearest appointment exposes one join control, unlocked only in the final ten minutes.
The review is a request after delivery, not a gate — it must be closeable.
The quote screen uses the house state illustration, like every other flow screen. The crane flipbook was tried here on 20 Aug and reverted on 23 Aug — it belongs to the app's own boot screen.
One state with a counter, not two headings in five seconds.
The address the quote returns to. Checkout scrolls to it and pulses it.
Post-payment pharmacy screen runs two stages in one heading: packing, then packed.
Orders carry their own progress bar in Activity once the pharmacy is done.
Medicine-order cards are explicitly identified as medicine before their status.
Treatment-programme cards are visually distinct from medicine orders while keeping the same card anatomy.
Sexual health books a time instead of matching a doctor; the slot picker is the screen.
Booking spans more than today, so the day picker must stay.
